entities.summary: Malacca Sultanate Palace Museum also known as the Melaka Sultanate Palace Museum is a museum located at the foot of St. Paul's Hill in Malacca City, Malacca, Malaysia. The building is a modern reconstruction of the palace of the Malacca Sultanate, based on the information and data obtained from the Malay Annals. It is made up of hardwood, 'belian' wood and wooden pegs and was constructed at a cost of MYR 3.09 million. Construction of this museum began in October 1984 and was completed in April 1986. The museum was officially opened on 17 July 1986 by Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad.
